item.title: The Relationship between Teachers' Work Engagement and Classroom Management Styles
item.description: This study reveals the levels of work engagement and the adoption of classroom management styles among physical education and sports teachers, investigates the association between these two variables, and compares them by demographics. To this end, the study, grounded in a quantitative paradigm, employed descriptive, correlational, and causal-comparative designs. item.title: Emotional and Behavioral Problems in Rural Adolescents: The Bangladeshi Example from a Gendered Perspective
item.description: Adolescent emotional and behavioral problems are highly prevalent yet often stigmatized. Within Bangladesh's male-dominated societal context, where traditional and religious norms disproportionately restrict women, gender becomes a pivotal factor for psychological well-being. This study therefore employs a gender-specific lens to explore these problems among secondary school students, examining their prevalence and variation across gender.
